notes: Nordstrom.com has no separate 'Clearance'/'Outlet' channel distinct from 'Sale' anywhere on the site: the site-wide sale hub (/browse/sale) is titled 'Sale & Clearance | Nordstrom' and its own sub-nav lists only 'New Markdowns', 'Bestsellers', 'Cold-Weather', 'Under $100/$50', department sections (Women/Men/Beauty/Kids/Designer/Home) and 'Gifts on Sale' - no link literally labeled just 'Clearance' or 'Outlet' exists apart from 'Sale'. The Home-scoped sale page (/browse/sale/home) carries the same umbrella title 'Home Sale & Clearance' (breadcrumb Home > Sale > Home, 11,844 items) and its banner reads 'End-of-Season Clearance: up to 50% off summer styles from your favorite brands' / 'Stock up on your favorites before they're gone'. This is genuinely ambiguous per the brief's Clearance-vs-Sale test: 'End-of-Season' + rotating sub-links (New Markdowns, Cold-Weather) signal a recurring seasonal promotional event (exclude-leaning), while the literal 'Clearance' in the page's own H1/title and 'before they're gone' (limited/non-restocking) language signal genuine outlet-style permanence (include-leaning). Recorded per instructions rather than guessing. Also checked and deliberately excluded as a separate row: /browse/sale/new-markdowns/home ('Home New Markdowns', 239 items, breadcrumb Home > Sale > New Markdowns > Home) - this is a facet of the same Sale department keyed on recency of markdown ('just discounted'), which is the opposite signal from clearance permanence, and is a strict subset of the 11,844-item Home Sale & Clearance listing, not a genuinely distinct merchandising concept - not included as its own row. Checked main Home nav, Home Decor category nav, and the full navigation-sitemap.xml for any other clearance/outlet/final-sale/last-chance/end-of-line URL under Home; none found beyond the Sale hierarchy above.
